<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <datamodel>
    <data id="count" expr="0"/>
    <data id="done" expr="false"/>
    <data id="user" expr="({name:'bob'})"/>
  </datamodel>
  <state id="a">
    <transition event="go" cond="In('bb')" target="b"/>
  </state>
  <final id="b"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: `In()` names `bb`, which is not a state of this machine
notes: `In()` is true only while a `<state>`, `<parallel>`, or `<final>` with this ID is active, so this condition is always false
